description_en: Queries the service status of the current user, which indicates whether the service is activated or has overdue payments
description_zh: 查询当前用户的服务状态，例如是否开通服务，是否欠费等
name: DescribeUserServiceStatus

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

Status.description_en:
The service status of the current user:

CLOSED: The service is not activated.

OPENED: The service is activated.

IN_DEBT: The service has an overdue payment.

IN_DEBT_OVER_DUE: The service is suspended due to an overdue payment
Status.description_zh:
当前用户的服务状态：

CLOSED：未开通
OPENED：已开通
IN_DEBT：已欠费
IN_DEBT_OVER_DUE： 欠费超期
